state := 12345
counts := array(13, fill = 0)
for: trial < 1000
    state = state * 48271 % 2147483647
    first := state % 6 + 1
    state = state * 48271 % 2147483647
    second := state % 6 + 1
    counts[first + second] += 1
most := 2
for: 2 <= sum <= 12
    println("{sum}: {counts[sum]}")
    if counts[sum] > counts[most]
        most = sum
println("most frequent: {most}")
